description: This PHP file generates a web page for adding an allowed device in a parental control management interface. It includes scripts for form validation, user interactions, and AJAX calls to manage device permissions and settings.

methods.name: updateAllowTimeVisibility
methods.description: Toggles the enable/disable state of allow time controls based on whether 'Always Allow' is selected.

methods.name: jProgress
methods.description: Displays a progress indicator with a message for a specified duration.

methods.name: jAlert
methods.description: Shows an alert dialog with a message.
